Read the passage given below and answer the questions that follow. 5 x 4 = 20
A society grows stronger when knowledge is shared rather than restricted. Education gives individuals the
ability to understand change, question assumptions and participate responsibly in public life. Technology has
made information easier to access, but access alone does not guarantee wisdom. People must learn to
examine evidence, distinguish fact from opinion and use information responsibly. The real value of education
therefore lies not only in what a person knows, but also in how that knowledge is used. A well-informed
citizen can contribute to a community by solving problems, respecting differences and making thoughtful
decisions.
